My own company runs on it daily. A.Team's move to production-ready agentic teammates built by forward deployed engineers is the work I already do: scoping, building and operating agents inside a client's environment, not wrapping a chatbot. Six live engagements; The Wall Group's AI workflow integration lifted net profit 17% year on year and funded a new site. Stack: Python, TypeScript, SQLite, REST APIs, browser automation, RAG and eval design, including rubric-graded, mutation-tested evals. Eighteen years of commercial and deep-tech leadership before that. Northern Ireland based, remote, available within four weeks.
